entities.summary: Paz Lenchantin (b. 1973-12-12, Mar del Plata) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mar del Plata and Argentina. Known in the fields of argentina, composers & musicians, americas.
